description: Runs SniffPup's free passive scan of a live website (takes up to about a minute) and returns the score and the issues found. Every critical issue comes with masked evidence, fix steps and a fix prompt (with no critical issue, one other issue does). The scan is for a site the user owns or has permission to test. It stores a scan and counts toward the free scan allowance. consent records the user's confirmation: I own this site or can test it, and agree to the Terms, including individual arbitration.

consent.description: Records the user's confirmation: I own this site or can test it, and agree to the Terms, including individual arbitration.

url.description: The live site to scan: an http or https URL, or a bare host such as your-app.com (https is assumed). At most 2048 characters. The server refuses other schemes and addresses that include a username or password.

name: scan_site
title: Free scan of a site
